Name: Better Artisan Style Items for Machine Progression System (MPS)
Author: Roseloves109
Description:
Credits to OGs: NachOnline for his amazing mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720]Machine Progression System (MPS)[/url] and Comkiens for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods mod. [/url]

I been playing With MPS for a long time and i noticed, the machines have textures packs. So i make this texture pack because i wanted the items to match BAG style items. I wanted to keep it to myself but i decided to release it. [b]Hope you guys enjoy it, let me know if there are any bugs. i fix them ASAP, also please dont forget to endorse the my mod please, so that way more people can see it. It helps inspires me to make mods/unofficial updates. ;)[/b]

Credits
Comkiens for their amazing texture packs, it inspired me to make this pack and packs for Mizus birds mod. 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39036]Chocoronron[/url], for inspiring me since she made Comkiens style packs (my favorite is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39269]Cornucopia pack[/url]) and i did heavily referenced her work.
